author: ryle
title: Expository Thoughts on the Gospels: St. Matthew
edition: Expository Thoughts on the Gospels, for Family and Private Use: St. Matthew (first published London, 1856); CCEL edition

rights.worldwide: to confirm: J. C. Ryle died in 1900; CCEL does not name the printing it transcribed, so which edition the text follows is still to confirm

notes: Matthew 1–28 are CCEL ryle/matthew ii.i–xxviii.ii, one page for each of Ryle's 93 sections. Ryle on Matthew is expository thoughts only, with no verse notes, so each section is kept whole, paragraph by paragraph in the order printed, in entries of up to about 350 words on the section's verses; a paragraph cut between entries is marked with ' ...'. CCEL's pages for 13:51-58 and 22:23-33 also hold the sections on 14:1-12, 14:13-21 and 22:34-46, each marked by an anchor heading ('mmatt14-1-12'), and those sections are on their own verses. CCEL heads the section on 9:27-38 'Matthew 9:27-37', though it expounds 9:38 ('Pray ye the Lord of the harvest'); it is on 9:27-38. The section headings are not repeated in the entries.
